ops.old: Flaky puff pastry twisted with sharp cheddar and parmesan, spotted with black olive and nigella seeds, baked crisp and golden. Lay out 2 thawed puff pastry sheets and brush with beaten egg. Scatter one with 80g grated cheddar, 30g parmesan, 50g finely chopped black olives and 1 tsp nigella seeds. Lay the second sheet on top and press down firmly. Cut into 1.5cm strips, twist each a few times and lay on lined trays. Bake at 200C for 15 minutes until golden and crisp.
